rules: Headings must use Oswald, ultra-tight tracking, and uppercase for that high-end athletic/editorial feel.
Never center headings globally. Left-align for editorial asymmetry or align to grid lines.
Use massive numbering (e.g., '01', '02') in JetBrains Mono or Oswald to structure the narrative (manifesto chapters).
Body copy must use Manrope for clean legibility against dark backgrounds.
Dark theme ONLY. Charcoal (#1A1A1A / #121212) serves as the base.
Bone (#F4F4F0) is used for text and borders.
Electric Blue (#4C63F5) is strictly reserved for kinetic interactions, hover states, and primary CTAs.
Do NOT use generic gradients. Solid dark colors with grain overlay.

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a subtle global noise/grain overlay (pointer-events-none, mix-blend-overlay, opacity-20) to kill digital flatness and enhance the cinematic feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use ultra-thin bone borders (border-[#F4F4F0]/10) to create structural grids (editorial layout).
visual_enhancers.images: Spotlights on subjects. Images should feel high-contrast, moody, and intense.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for the sticky navigation: bg-[#121212]/70, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-[#F4F4F0]/10.

grids_layouts.spacing: Extreme spacing. Use py-24, py-32, or py-40 between sections to create dramatic breathing room.
patterns: Asymmetric Hero: Giant typography overlapping images, heavy left-alignment.
Grid Borders: Use CSS grid with visible 1px borders for the Membership Pricing and Programs section to give a structured, raw, athletic feel.
Editorial Rhythms: Alternate between full-bleed imagery and dense, multi-column typographic data.
Smooth Scrolling: Initialize Lenis for premium momentum scrolling across the entire page.
Hero Reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal on load using Framer Motion (staggered overflow-hidden containers).
Parallax: Subtle y-axis parallax on large background images or floating elements.
Editorial Marquee: Ultra-slow, continuously scrolling text ribbon reading 'SYNERGY GROUP FITNESS // NO EXCUSES // TRANSFORM YOUR POTENTIAL // ' in large outline typography.
Hover States: Images should have subtle scale up (1.05) and desaturation-to-color reveals.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Bone text against Charcoal background meets WCAG AAA standards.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings must use Electric Blue (#4C63F5) with 2px offset.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all Framer Motion and Lenis integrations.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden for purely decorative oversized numbers.

instructions: Since this is a high-end marketing page, rely primarily on raw HTML + Tailwind + Framer Motion for layouts to ensure complete control over asymmetry.
Do NOT use Shadcn Card components—build custom sections with border-collapse grids.
Buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. Solid Electric Blue background, Bone text. Hover: slightly darker blue or outlined.
Accordions (if used for FAQs/Programs): Customize to remove default borders and use massive 1px bone/10 dividers.

image_urls.description: Cinematic shirtless man lifting barbell. Use with a heavy dark gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#121212] via-[#121212]/80 to-transparent).
Man hanging upside down in the dark. Perfect for a full-screen parallax transition section representing discipline.
Male trainer under vibrant blue neon lights. Matches Electric Blue theme perfectly.
Row of exercise machines in dark cinematic lighting.
Dark hallway with neon sign. Creates spatial depth.

rules: Never use full-screen flat blanket overlays. Use directional gradients or vignette effects.
Clip images inside geometric frames (e.g., extremely tall/narrow aspect ratios) for an editorial feel.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do NOT build a generic SaaS landing page. This is an Awwwards-level, high-end editorial fitness site. Prioritize art direction.
Inject Lenis into the root layout for smooth scrolling (MANDATORY). Use `@studio-freight/react-lenis`.
Use Framer Motion to create a large kinetic hero section with a line-by-line text reveal.
Include a slow editorial marquee section using raw CSS animations or Framer Motion.
Implement dramatically asymmetrical grids and oversized numbers (e.g., 01, 02) to label sections.
Do not use emojis anywhere in the design or code.
Never center align the main app container. Emphasize strong left-alignment or grid-based structures.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
Add a subtle grain/noise overlay across the entire site to enhance the cinematic aesthetic.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons for minimalist, sharp iconography.
Ensure the hero overlay max opacity is bg-black/50 so the image remains visible.
